title: clermontia peleana subsp. singuliflora
intro: Clermontia peleana subsp. singuliflora, commonly known as the Kauai clermontia, is a rare flowering plant species endemic to the island of Kauai in Hawaii. This plant is a subspecies of Clermontia peleana, a flowering plant in the lily family. Clermontia peleana subsp. singuliflora has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
